CUMBERLAND GAP, July 23, [1862]. Col. J. B. FRY : Your telegrams of the 19th or 20th just received. The cipher was unintelligible, and had to be repeated. Lieutenant Craighill belongs to the Engineer Corps. He has been [here?] ten days. He came under orders from the Secretary of War. This place could no more be held by one regiment than by one man.
